newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis weak, harvest picks up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis weak, harvest picks up.

text.p: FOB Gulf soybean basis values were weaker on Monday as harvesting in the U.S. Midwest gathered pace amid almost ideal weather.
"The harvest is going along real well and the pipeline is getting full again," one soybean trader said.

Corn basis levels, however, were slightly stronger, boosted by slow farmer selling. A pickup in corn harvesting in the Midwest is expected in the next couple of weeks and should ensure the advance in values proves short-lived, traders said.
Wheat basis values were steady in quiet conditions.
